name: Strict Crypto Policy
description: Strict policy: blocks SHA-1 based algorithms and legacy PRNGs. Warns on all block ciphers pending PQC review.

notes.RSA: Vulnerable to quantum attacks (Shor's algorithm). Plan migration to ML-KEM/ML-DSA.
notes.DSA: Vulnerable to quantum attacks. Plan migration to ML-DSA.
notes.block-cipher: Block ciphers should be reviewed for PQC readiness and mode of operation.
